releases.displayName: Nightmare Mode, Story Mode and Patch Update Available Now

items.text: Today's update introduces two new ways to experience Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy, alongside a range of fixes and improvements across gameplay, progression, visuals, audio, and UI.
These additions are the result of ongoing feedback from you, and we want to thank everyone who has shared suggestions, bug reports, and impressions since launch.
Free to Explore
Explore, uncover secrets, and immerse yourself in the story with minimal interruptions.
Stalkers are mostly absent, allowing you to focus on the mysteries hidden throughout Villa Ashmann and experience the narrative at your own pace.
More Pressure from Stalkers
Prepare for a more intense nightmare.
Stalkers are more present and relentless, leaving you less time to catch your breath as you struggle to survive.
New Features
Added two new difficulty options: Story Mode and Nightmare Mode
Added a video option to unlock the frame rate in cutscenes
Gameplay & Progression
Fixed a progression blocker in the First Convent
Fixed a door in the Dark Room that could remain locked
Respawning after death in the Residential Wing no longer skips a stalker encounter
Fixed a swapped weapon disappearing in the Residential Wing
Skipping cutscenes now works correctly in all cases
Fixed doors in the Noble Wing staying open after reloading a save
AI & Enemies
Novices now correctly interrupt mirror inspection
Fixed mirror inspection triggering unintentionally after being caught by a stalker
Fixed an enemy moving through closed doors in the Dining Room
Fixed an enemy floating in the Catacombs
Visuals & Level
Fixed character clipping that could occur in Boris' Studio
Fixed character clipping through the floor when reloading a specific save
Fixed V-Sync behavior when enabling FSR Frame Generation
Fixed a chandelier popping in during a cutscene
Audio
Fixed daytime ambience playing in some instances after loading a nighttime save
Fixed exterior audio playing during an indoor cutscene
Fixed exterior sounds toggling on and off in the Residential Wing
Fixed ambient sound cutting in and out in the Residential Wing
UI & Controls
Fixed the key item notification alignment on some UI scales and aspect ratios
Long save slot names now scroll to fit all languages
The opening video is no longer stretched on non-16:9 screens
Fixed a blurry interaction prompt at lower resolutions
Fixed incorrect icons in the Controls view when using a controller on PC
Localization
Fixed wrong speaker names in the Collectibles menu
Fixed subtitle errors in the Second Convent
Fixed a trophy description in Spanish
Fixed an incorrect button prompt in Polish
